'''Arisa Shida''' (Japanese: '''志田有彩''' ''Shida Arisa'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Shida was born on October 3rd, in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan and became a voice actor as an adult. Shida joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|HZ}}, voicing [[Onia]] from the [[Explorers]].
